concept_fusion: Tactical Military C2 (Command & Control) + Air Traffic Control Telemetry + Swiss Grid Brutalism. This eliminates 'SaaS CRM' aesthetics, focusing on absolute legibility, strict data containment, and zero-latency decision making under high-stress scenarios.

theme_strategy.command_center: Dark Theme Default. Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A) background to reduce eye strain during 24/7 operations.
theme_strategy.citizen_field_app: High-Contrast Light Theme Default. Pure White (#FFFFFF) background for high visibility outdoors under direct sunlight.
theme_strategy.rule: Never mix dark and light elements on the same surface. The system must feel like a rigid instrument panel, not a consumer web app.

macro_typography.style: Heavy weight (800/900), uppercase exclusively, compressed line-height (leading-none), and negative tracking (tracking-tighter). Scaled via fluid clamps (e.g., text-4xl to text-6xl+).

micro_typography.usage: Data tables, Status Codes, Coordinates, Timestamps, Simulation Tags, Log Outputs
micro_typography.style: Small scale (text-xs to text-sm), regular weight, tracking-widest for data blocks. All operational metadata must be uppercase.

body_typography.style: Highly legible, text-base, leading-relaxed. Banned from being used as headings in the Command Center.

backgrounds.rule: DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for any overlay, header, floating panel, or dropdown. Content must sit on solid, opaque backgrounds.

status_signals.rule: Use high-saturation signal colors EXCLUSIVELY for status and alerts. Never for decorative UI chrome.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Bimodal Density. Use a strict 4px base unit. Micro-data must be tightly packed (gap-1, gap-2). Macro-sections must be separated by vast negative space (gap-12, gap-16).
grids_and_layouts.architecture: CSS Grid strictly. No floating elements without solid 1px containment borders.
grids_and_layouts.command_center: 100% Viewport Height. Background is the Live Tactical Map. UI consists of solid, opaque, left/right vertical bento-grid panels (w-96) pinned to edges. No soft shadows; use 1px solid technical borders.
grids_and_layouts.mobile_web: Map-centric top half, swipeable bottom sheet for actions (Citizen/Responder). Actions are full-width, massive touch targets (h-16).

surface_strategies.borders_and_radii: Utilitarian Sharpness. Max border-radius is 2px (rounded-sm). Reject pill-shaped consumer buttons. Panels are rectangular boxes delineated by solid 1px lines.
surface_strategies.shadows: BANNED. Do not use elevation shadows. Depth is communicated purely through z-index containment and border contrast.
surface_strategies.transparency: BANNED. Dropdowns, Dialogs, and Overlays MUST use a solid background (e.g., bg-zinc-950) with a 1px border. Refraction/blur kills text contrast in emergency scenarios.

component_guidelines.status_badges: Rectangular, 1px border matching the text color, transparent background (if sitting on solid surface) or solid background. Font: JetBrains Mono uppercase. E.g., [SYNCING], [LOCAL_ONLY], [DEGRADED], [SATELLITE_BACKHAUL], [MOCKED], [SIMULATED].
component_guidelines.ai_recommendation_cards: Must explicitly show 'Critic Result' and 'Confidence %' using monospace tags. Use a distinct subtle dashed border to differentiate from human-verified data.
component_guidelines.citizen_emergency_actions: Massive block buttons. 'NEED RESCUE' (Solid #FF3B30 bg, Black text), 'REPORT HAZARD' (Solid #FFB020 bg, Black text), 'I AM SAFE' (Solid #00FF66 bg, Black text).
component_guidelines.approval_queue: High-risk decisions isolated in a modal or dedicated panel with explicit ACCEPT/REJECT blocks. Stale data must show 'Updated Xs ago' in Amber.

offline_first_patterns.stale_indicators: Data older than 5 minutes must have a 'STALE' badge and a 'Last synced: [time]' timestamp in the UI.
offline_first_patterns.sync_queue_viewer: Provide an Outbound Queue panel in the Command Center showing pending requests to the mesh/satellite network.
offline_first_patterns.graceful_degradation: If [LOCAL_ONLY], action buttons must not disappear; they remain active but queue locally, displaying a '[QUEUED]' tag immediately upon press.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Invert colors on hover. Black background with Cyan text becomes Cyan background with Black text.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Instant or ultra-fast (75ms). No long, drawn-out animations. Emergency ops require perceived zero-latency.
motion_and_interactions.spinners: Use ASCII or rigid block loaders (e.g., [///...]) rather than circular consumer spinners.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AAA compliance for text. Use Text-Shadow (1px black) if overlaying text directly on map layers (though solid panels are preferred).
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements, status badges, and action buttons MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='btn-citizen-need-rescue').

responder_avatars.description: Portraits for Responder field app assignments

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a resilient, offline-first Command Center and Field App. The UI must look like an industrial, high-precision telemetry instrument, not a SaaS CRM.
Always apply solid background colors to floating elements to prevent content bleed. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for panels, dropdowns, or headers.
Data states (SYNCED, STALE, LOCAL_ONLY, MESH_ONLY) must be explicit, prominent monospace badges. Never hide connectivity status behind generic icons.
Implement the bimodal density layout: pack data tightly using JetBrains Mono, but frame those tight data blocks with generous negative space.
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY button, input, tab, and mission action card.
Use Phosphor Icons (sharp/regular) or Lucide icons for UI symbolism, but rely heavily on uppercase monospace text for status.
AI generated recommendations MUST be clearly demarcated with 'SIMULATED' or 'AI RECOMMENDATION' tags.
Ensure map components (e.g., react-map-gl) have properly defined explicit z-indexes to stay beneath the UI panels.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and strict borders.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container. Preserve natural reading flows.
DO NOT use AI assistant emoji characters.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
